blocks.text: Greesum 3 Pieces Rocking Patio Furniture Sets

Feature:
 Modern fashion rocking design for your modern life
 Easy to move because of its material (Rattan) is so light
 Easy to assemble with the complete tools and detailed instructions
 Outstanding manufacture technology make the chairs looks very well and exquisite
 Padded cushions can make you feel comfortable and soft when you are sitting on it
 Anti rust and anti-corrosion process make the rocking chair set has longer service life
 Rattan wicker has outstanding sturdy to stand your weight and the material looks like very smooth
 It can be widely used in differnt scenarios such as can use it to have a nice afternoon tea or read books in your yard

Specification:
 Color: Beige
 Material: Rattan wicker, metal and glass
 Table Dimensions: 17" x 17" x 19"
 Rocking Chair Dimensions: 23" x 28.5" x 36"
 Package Dimensions: 29.53"(L) x 25.99"(W) x 9.85"(H)
 Weight: 46.3 lbs

Package includes:
 A tool kit
 Beige Cushions
 Two single rocking seats
 A glass rattan table
 A manual of installation and usage
Notice: There may be some differences between the photos and products in terms of color due to the influence of the lighting during the process of shooting or the settings of display screen

items.label: Chic Design
items.value: Rocking design helps you sit more relaxed and comfortable, but you don't have to worry about falling down. The balance design of the chair is very good. You just need to relax and sit on it to chat with your friends.

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: The chair is made of strong metal and firm rattan. You don't have to worry about its firmness, and the anti rust and anti-corrosion process makes it able to face all weather and has longer service time.

items.label: Rattan Glass Table
items.value: The table can be used to put the ornaments such as small flowerpot, it can also be used to put mobile phone, fruit plate or wine glass when you are reading or chatting with your friends.

items.label: Easy To Move
items.value: Because the materials are light, you can move the chairs to the suitable place easily such as poolside, garden, yard, porch or balcony wherever you want to put it. It is just depend on your like.

items.label: Easy Assembly
items.value: A detailed installation with a complete tool kit will help you assemble the chair without any difficult. You can assemble it quickly, the assemble process will not cause you much time.

items.label: Set Name
items.value: Greesum 3 Pieces Rocking Wicker Bistro Set

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Two Rocking Chairs and A Glass Coffee Table

items.label: Item Type Name
items.value: 3 Pieces Patio Furniture Set, Outdoor Bistro Rattan Wicker Rocking Chair Set, Conversation Sets with Soft Cushion and Glass Coffee Table, Design for Poolside Yard Garden

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe with Damp Cloth, Wiper with Dry

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly required. Comes with a complete tool kit and detailed instructions.
